spec_match.rationale: Detects the lock's observable signature — scroll event runs where one axis delta is exactly zero — on panes with and without the property.

interactive.rationale: Recorder buttons and programmatic control ran; event log and verdicts rendered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes programmatic scrolls (never locked) from gestures, and says when a verdict cannot be reached.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Programmatic control exercised cleanly; real-gesture branch requires touch input (see sibling's open question).

accessibility.rationale: Controls named, log textual, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Recorder logic sound; the genuine gesture signature needs a touch session (tracked on diagonal-pan).
